notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Bugfixes and tweaks:

 Sheep drinking unreliability fixed
 Barriers to stop players from walking off the map
 Tweaked animation on the introduction text
 Tweaks to the locations of tutorials so that they are more intuitive
 Reconfiguration of obstacle locations
 Fixed several instances of floating objects
 Fixed several issues that arose when players interacted with the camping system
 Small updates to some of the music tracks
 Assortment of other minor fixes
 Updates to the credits


New Content:

 All new menu system with graphical, audio, and controls/keybinds settings
 Fade out once the end of the currently playable level is reached
 New face cameras for sheep
 Updated decorations across various points of the map.
 Magical footprint tracking enabled
